```yaml
name: Backend Required Quality Gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  # Job to classify paths and determine if backend changes are present
  path-filter:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      backend-changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.backend }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Filter paths
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            backend:
              - 'tldw_Server_API/**'
              - 'requirements*.txt'
              - 'pyproject.toml'
              - 'setup.py'
              - '.github/workflows/backend*.yml'

  # Backend Quality Gate: Runs tests and linting if backend files changed
  backend-quality-gate:
    needs: path-filter
    if: ${{ needs.path-filter.outputs.backend-changed == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest bandit
          # Assuming requirements are in a standard file, adjust if necessary
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi

      - name: Run CI Contract Tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

      - name: Run Bandit Security Lint on CI Tests
        run: |
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

      - name: Upload Bandit Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bandit-report
          path: /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

  # Security Gate: Dependency Review and Static Analysis
  security-gate:
    needs: path-filter
    if: ${{ needs.path-filter.outputs.backend-changed == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Dependency Review
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v4
        with:
          fail-on-severity: high
          comment-summary-in-pr: always

      - name: No-op Pass for Security Gate
        if: ${{ needs.path-filter.outputs.backend-changed == 'false' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
        run: echo "No backend changes detected, skipping security gate checks."

  # Coverage Gate: Ensure coverage thresholds are met
  coverage-gate:
    needs: path-filter
    if: ${{ needs.path-filter.outputs.backend-changed == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest pytest-cov
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi

      - name: Run Tests with Coverage
        run: |
          python -m pytest --cov=tldw_Server_API --cov-report=xml tldw_Server_API/tests/

      - name: Upload Coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: true

      - name: No-op Pass for Coverage Gate
        if: ${{ needs.path-filter.outputs.backend-changed == 'false' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
        run: echo "No backend changes detected, skipping coverage gate checks."

  # Final Gate: Ensure all required jobs passed
  required-gate:
    needs: [backend-quality-gate, security-gate, coverage-gate]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check if all required jobs passed
        if: >-
          ${{ 
            (needs.backend-quality-gate.result == 'success' || needs.backend-quality-gate.result == 'skipped') &&
            (needs.security-gate.result == 'success' || needs.security-gate.result == 'skipped') &&
            (needs.coverage-gate.result == 'success' || needs.coverage-gate.result == 'skipped')
          }}
        run: echo "All required quality gates passed."

      - name: Fail if any required job failed
        if: >-
          ${{ 
            (needs.backend-quality-gate.result != 'success' && needs.backend-quality-gate.result != 'skipped') ||
            (needs.security-gate.result != 'success' && needs.security-gate.result != 'skipped') ||
            (needs.coverage-gate.result != 'success' && needs.coverage-gate.result != 'skipped')
          }}
        run: |
          echo "One or more required quality gates failed."
          exit 1
```
